title: Spirit of the Wild Horse
description: A surreal double exposure painting merging a woman's face in profile with a vast green landscape. Two horses stand in the misty hills while translucent orbs filled with intricate indigenous patterns float across the scene. The woman's face features red ceremonial dots, is partially covered by large autumn leaves, and her hair flows into the environment.
prompt: surreal double exposure artwork of a woman's face in profile with red ceremonial face paint and large autumn leaves covering part of her features, merging with a misty green rolling hills landscape, two realistic horses standing in the midground, translucent spirit orbs containing intricate indigenous geometric patterns floating in the sky, dramatic sunset clouds, mystical atmosphere, painterly style with visible brushwork
